name: Voxtral TTS 3
access: Mistral API: POST /v1/audio/speech (offline, with optional streamed response) and the WebSocket wss://api.mistral.ai/v1/audio/speech/realtime; API names voxtral-mini-tts-3-0, voxtral-mini-tts-3, voxtral-mini-tts-latest and the -realtime- variants [mistral-tts3-page] [mistral-tts-realtime]
Mistral Voice Agents SDK, as the speech stage of its pipeline [mistral-voice-agents]

voice.input_audio: Text with optional inline tags; optional audio: a ref_audio clip for zero-shot cloning (MP3 or WAV, base64, a few seconds to a few minutes) or conversation_history turns with base64 audio for contextual delivery [mistral-tts-formats] [mistral-tts-generate]
voice.output_audio: mp3 (offline default), wav (realtime default), pcm, flac or opus; mono at 24 kHz [mistral-tts-formats] [mistral-tts-realtime]
voice.voices: 36 Voxtral 3 preset voices (realtime default voice_447), the 30 Voxtral 2 preset IDs (4 speakers, one ID per emotion), zero-shot clones and saved voices, and professional voice cloning from 30 minutes to 3 hours of audio [mistral-tts-voices] [mistral-voices-concept]
languages: 35 languages with 50+ regional dialects; preset voices exist in 22 of the listed languages, and the rest need a cloned voice; the language follows the voice and the text, not a request parameter [mistral-tts-languages] [mistral-tts3-page]
Emotion, pace and disfluency tags work in English and are untested but expected to work in French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese and Hindi [mistral-tts-tags]
voice.turn_detection: Not applicable; a synthesis model does not listen
voice.interruption: Not a conversation model; in a realtime session input_text.flush ends one generation and input_text.end closes the session [mistral-tts-realtime]
voice.latency: Mistral: about 90 ms time to first audio with streaming [mistral-tts3-page]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: Per character, not per token: US$13 per million input characters on Mistral's API pricing page and model page [mistral-pricing] [mistral-tts3-page]

benchmarks.name: Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Elo (provider voice leaderboard)
benchmarks.setting: blind listener votes on each provider's own voices; accent and category set to All; rank 15 (range 13 to 19), 95% interval 1209 to 1237, 2,008 samples, 8 voices; listed as Voxtral 3 TTS; the page's per-accent and per-category boards give other values

sources.quote: Style instructions are not available at launch.

unknown: weights: no open weights found; the Hugging Face listing of Mistral's Voxtral repositories read on 2026-10-31 shows Voxtral-4B-TTS-2603 and no Voxtral 3 speech model, while the launch post offers self-deployment without naming a licence [hf-mistral-models] [mistral-voxtral3-post]
context_window: not applicable to a synthesis model; no input-length limit in characters was found in the pages read
voice.session_limit: the realtime page states no maximum session length
voice.languages: the docs say 35 languages, while the language table lists 38 languages (English as two rows) [mistral-tts-languages]
voice.voices: the voice library lists 7 UK English and 4 US English Voxtral 3 voices, while the language table counts 6 and 4 [mistral-tts-voices] [mistral-tts-languages]
pricing_usd_per_mtok: the unit differs; the price is per million input characters, not per token

prompting_guides: the guides disagree on pace tags; the model page and the limits page give two values (slow, fast), while the tag page lists five (very-slow, slow, moderate, fast, very-fast) [mistral-tts3-page] [mistral-tts-limits] [mistral-tts-tags]

access: the migration page says voxtral-mini-tts-latest will point to Voxtral 3 within a month of general availability, while the model page already lists the alias [mistral-migrate-voxtral2] [mistral-tts3-page]
system_card: Mistral publishes no system card or model card for the Voxtral 3 models in the pages read

benchmarks: the launch post gives only charts of Mistral-run and vendor-run tests (Voice Code Bench by BeSimple AI, internal evaluations judged by gemini-3.8-flash) without per-model figures in its text, so no maker score is recorded; the one independent figure is the Artificial Analysis Speech Arena Elo [mistral-voxtral3-post] [aa-tts-board]
